items.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Babs Gonzalez set that up. He brought Jimmy to New York and told Alfred he should record him.

ctx.x: Where I’m going is, was it set up by the record company? Was it your initiative?
No. Babs Gonzalez set that up. He brought Jimmy to New York and told Alfred he should record him. So Babs was in the middle of that.
So Jimmy Smith got the date, and then you got the call to do the record?
